completedWork: Implemented the four helpers and a 21-case node:test self-test, all passing (ev:ev-muyodvof-01e95e26, ~0.9 s). APIs: http-client.request({port, method, path, headers, body, setHost=true, hostname='127.0.0.1', timeoutMs=10000}) -> {status, headers, body, json|null}; a `host` header (any case) overrides Host, setHost:false with no host header sends none; string/Buffer body sent byte-for-byte, other values JSON-stringified with content-type application/json only if none given; content-length always set unless supplied; rejects on transport errors (ECONNREFUSED/ECONNRESET/ETIMEDOUT). fake-fetch: respond(status, jsonOrText), messageBody(obj, opts) (body object), messageOk(obj, {stop_reason='end_turn', thinkingFirst=false, usage, model}) (stub; body also on stub.body; usage default {input_tokens:120, output_tokens:40}, usage:null omits the key; a string obj is used verbatim as the text block), never() (never settles even on abort), throws(err=TypeError('fetch failed')) (rejects), capture(inner) (records {url, init, body: parsed|null, rawBody} before delegating; .calls, .count). fake-anthropic: startFakeAnthropic() -> {port, address, url, requests[{method,path,headers,body,json}], count (on arrival), reply(status, jsonOrText, {once, headers}), replyMessage(obj, opts, {once}), redirect(3xx, location, {once}), reset(), close()}; binds 127.0.0.1 (loopback-only enforced); unprogrammed requests get 500 api_error. spawn-server: buildChildEnv(testEnv) and spawnServer({env, entry='src/server.js', cwd=project root, timeoutMs=10000}) -> {child, env, port, listening, stdout(), stderr(), logs(), waitForLog(pred,{timeoutMs}), stop()}; spawns process.execPath (no PATH lookup), rejects with exitCode/stderr on early exit, kills and rejects on listening timeout, stop() is SIGTERM then SIGKILL after 3 s and idempotent, plus a process-exit SIGKILL safety net. Self-test covers: Host default/foreign/missing/[::1] and Origin; body encodings and 20 KB body; HEAD; ECONNREFUSED rejection; capture url/init/parsed body/count (also with never inner); never() pending before and after abort; thinkingFirst order; fake-anthropic programmed 200 + recorded headers/body, once-queue, reset, unprogrammed 500; 307 and 308 to a second instance at http://localhost:<B>: fetch redirect:'error' throws TypeError and B counts 0, with a follow-mode control proving B's counter is live (B counts 1 via localhost); DES-1 with parent ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/TRIAGE_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL set: child env keys are exactly the test keys + PATH + PORT, PORT forced to '0', parent key absent from child output; early-exit and timeout paths. A mutation check (spawn-server spreading process.env, on a scratch copy) is caught by two self-test cases (ev:ev-muyodwft-010ec996).
